text:
deploybot: Scheduled migration for users.events table at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Attach safepoint=60, holdpoints pre-quiesce & post-apply. Command:
```
/deploy start migrate --id=2026-03-21-dbusers --safepoint=60 --holdpoints=pre-quiesce,post-apply --canary=5%
```

Matt H: I'll take lead on quiesce. Plan: stop writers via feature-flag -> wait inflight=0 -> safepoint -> apply schema + backfill.

Eva L: What's the backfill throttling? want to cap to 300 rows/s to keep p99 <200ms. Also prefer incremental checkpoints.

Cassie: Please pin read side to app tag v3.12.1 during rollout so older workers don't write new column names.

oncall-sre: @Matt H post runbook link and rollback checklist. If we stall > 10m at any holdpoint we abort and unquiesce.

Matt H: runbook: https://wiki.redwood.internal/runbooks/db-migrate-users (internal). Rollback plan: snapshot-restore + revert feature-flag + revert schema migration via deploybot, steps in runbook.

Cassie: Preflight SQL sanity check to run right before safepoint:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM users.events WHERE processed=false AND created_at < now() - interval '7 days';
```
If > 500k we'll reduce batch size.

Eva L: Add deploybot holdpoint 'post-apply-validate' to verify event counts + consumer lag. Canary window 10m then ramp.

deploybot: Holdpoints registered: pre-quiesce, post-apply-validate. Canary: 5% tenants for 10m, then 25% for 10m, then full.

Matt H: Adding backfill governor: --backfill-rate=300 rows/s, retries=2, checkpoint-every=1m. Using deploy param `--backfill-rate=300`.

oncall-sre: Monitoring: create alerts: replication_lag > 30s, p99_write_latency > 250ms, job_error_rate > 1%. I'll wire alerts to #oncall.

Cassie: Drafting release notes entry now: "DB migration: users.events add indexed status column; backfill throttled to limit tail latency." Will post PR in docs.

Eva L: Rollback criteria: error-rate > 1% OR processed throughput drop > 20% for 5m OR consumer lag spike. If criteria hit, abort and run rollback runbook.

Matt H: Emergency abort commands (kept handy):
```
/deploy abort --id=2026-03-21-dbusers
/feature-flag toggle users-events-write off
```

deploybot: Preflight checks scheduled at 22:40 UTC. Quiesce signal at 22:58 UTC. Canary start 23:00 UTC. Tagging @oncall-sre.

oncall-sre: I will be on call for the window, available on pager. Ping in-thread at holdpoints.

Cassie: :thumbsup: I'll pin app release and coordinate client SDK rollout to avoid write mismatches.

Matt H: I'll post live check-ins: "preflight ok", "quiesced", "post-apply validation ok". If anything blocks I will escalate here.

Eva L: One more: please include query to verify counts after backfill (post-apply):
```
SELECT status, count(*) FROM users.events GROUP BY status;
```
Compare against snapshot pre-migration.

Matt H: noted. Good to proceed on preflight.

Cassie: thanks all. I'll update release notes PR and tag docs reviewer.

deploybot: Acknowledged. I'll enforce holdpoints and publish canary metrics to the rollout dashboard.
